messages:
Hana (PM): Quick thread: propose adding a compliance/legal handshake to private deploy upgrades. Motivation: auditors want an immutable record tying network-impact decisions to approvals. Key pieces: consent preset, preflight artifact, signed-approval token, and a legal sign-off step for tier-2 (peering).

Eli (eng): Implementation idea: installer produces preflight.json + bundle.sha and a signed_approval_token if operator-run requires net changes. Token includes install_id + plan_sha + signer (netops) and is recorded in audit logs. CLI example:
```
installer --preset=peer --dry-run
# prints plan_sha: 9f7a...
# after netops signs: installer install --approval-token tok-xyz
```
We store preflight in assets with immutable path and hash.

Pri (field): Field asks for a one-click "issue to netops" flow: generate preflight, prefill signoff template (ASN, windows, impact), and email/link to netops with expected maintenance window. Also needs airgap-signed bundle for customers.

Oscar (netops): Netops wants legal to be cc'ed for tier-2 installs. Sign-off must include: ASN, neighbor IPs, expected egress IPs, maintenance window, and a reconciliation plan if egress changes. Also require a short justification string stored in audit logs.

audit-bot: audit-bot: preflight artifact stored at assets/prod/pilotX/preflight-4955550000.json sha256=9f7a...

Hana (PM): Launch gates suggestion (compliance-focused):
- Preflight PASS on 3 pilot customers from distinct compliance regimes (SOC2, ISO, GDPR region).
- Legal sign-off exercised once for a tier-2 pilot (end-to-end).
- Signed-bundle verification for airgap customers.
- Audit trail validated: approval token present in logs and linked to plan_sha.
If met -> GA.

Eli (eng): Action items:
- produce token format + signer flow (ETA 5d)
- write immutability policy for assets (TTL/retention) and implement asset path (ETA 1w)

Pri (field): Action items:
- draft one-pager for field with email template + playbook for airgap signed-bundle (ETA 3d)

Oscar (netops): Action items:
- signoff template + checklist for legal + netops (ETA 3d). Keep preserve-egress default=false and require explicit checkbox to attempt preserve.

Hana (PM): Also add an observable metric: "approval_latency" (time between preflight publish and netops sign-off) and alert if >72h for any tier-2 pilot. We'll keep defaults conservative and surface everything in console. End.
